verdict.rationale: Okta publishes an official open-source MCP server (github.com/okta/okta-mcp-server) that lets LLMs and AI agents run Okta Admin Management API operations in natural language, such as creating users, listing failed logins, and finding unused apps. A first-party developer blog post announcing it and a probe confirming the documented server corroborate this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and evidenced setup/auth configuration details for MCP clients.
